# ezghcloud_waf (Resource)

A WAF: custom rules and managed rule sets that inspect requests to the load balancers it's attached to. Attach it with ezghcloud_load_balancer_waf. An attached WAF can't be deleted, so a change that replaces it needs lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ezghcloud_waf" "web" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  name       = "web"

  managed_rule_sets = [
    { name = "ezgh/core" },
    # Record what the PHP rules would block before turning them on.
    { name = "ezgh/php", mode = "log" },
  ]

  rules = [
    {
      name       = "office"
      action     = "allow"
      conditions = [{ type = "ipSet", cidrs = ["203.0.113.0/24"] }]
    },
    {
      name       = "login"
      action     = "rateLimit"
      rate_limit = { limit = 20, window_seconds = 60 }
      conditions = [
        { type = "equals", target = "path", value = "/login" },
        { type = "equals", target = "method", value = "POST" },
      ]
    },
  ]

  logging = { scope = "matched", environment = "production" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, 1 to 100 characters.
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier. Changing it replaces the WAF.

### Optional

- `default_action` (String) What happens to a request no rule ends: allow.
- `description` (String) Description, at most 500 characters; null clears it.
- `logging` (Attributes) Request logs to Observability. Defaults to off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logging))
- `managed_rule_sets` (Attributes List) Managed rule sets, run in order after the custom rules. Each set at most once. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--managed_rule_sets))
- `mode` (String) block, or log to record every block of the WAF without blocking. Defaults to block.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Custom rules, top to bottom; the first that ends a request wins. At most 100. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags.

### Read-Only

- `attachments` (List of String) Load balancers (lbr_) the WAF is attached to.
- `id` (String) WAF ID (waf_).
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `resource_name` (String) IAM resource name.
- `status` (String) active.
- `version` (Number) Rises on every change; updates are conditional on it.

<a id="nestedatt--logging"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logging`

Required:

- `scope` (String) off, matched (the requests a rule matched) or all.

Optional:

- `environment` (String) Observability environment in the WAF's project; required unless scope is off. Turning logging on needs obs.logs.ingest on the project.


<a id="nestedatt--managed_rule_sets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `managed_rule_sets`

Required:

- `name` (String) ezgh/core (Core rule set (OWASP CRS)), ezgh/php (PHP), ezgh/node (Node.js) or ezgh/known-bad-inputs (Known bad inputs).

Optional:

- `mode` (String) block, or log to record what the set would block without blocking it. Defaults to block.
- `paranoia_level` (Number) ezgh/core only: 1 or 2, higher catching more attacks and more false positives. Defaults to 1; null for other sets.
- `rule_overrides` (Attributes List) Rules of the set to turn off, or (except in ezgh/core) to log only, for false positives. At most 100. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--managed_rule_sets--rule_overrides))

<a id="nestedatt--managed_rule_sets--rule_overrides"></a>
### Nested Schema for `managed_rule_sets.rule_overrides`

Required:

- `action` (String) off or log.
- `rule_id` (Number) A rule of the set.



<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `action` (String) allow skips the remaining rules and the managed rule sets; block answers 403; log records the request and continues; rateLimit counts matching requests per client IP and blocks (or logs) a client over the limit.
- `conditions` (Attributes List) 1 to 5 conditions, all of which must match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--conditions))
- `name` (String) Unique in the WAF: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

Optional:

- `mode` (String) rateLimit rules only: block or log. Defaults to block; null for other actions.
- `rate_limit` (Attributes) rateLimit rules only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--rate_limit))

<a id="nestedatt--rules--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.conditions`

Required:

- `type` (String) ipSet, asn, country, regex, contains or equals.

Optional:

- `case_sensitive` (Boolean) regex, contains and equals: whether case matters. Defaults to false; null for other types.
- `cidrs` (List of String) ipSet: IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and CIDR blocks, 1 to 1,000.
- `codes` (List of String) country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes in capitals, 1 to 250.
- `negate` (Boolean) Match when the condition doesn't hold. Defaults to false.
- `numbers` (List of Number) asn: autonomous system numbers the client's address is announced by, 1 to 100.
- `target` (String) regex, contains and equals: path, query, method, body (the first 16 KB of a request body), header:<name> or cookie:<name>.
- `value` (String) regex, contains and equals: what the target is compared with, at most 1,024 bytes. A regex has no backreferences or lookaround.


<a id="nestedatt--rules--rate_limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.rate_limit`

Required:

- `limit` (Number) Requests a client IP may make in the window, 1 to 100,000.
- `window_seconds` (Number) 60, 300 or 600.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_waf.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/waf_ID'
```
